title.zh: 设立西明多洛契约登记官办事处分支机构，常设站设于西明多洛San Jose的法案
title.en: An Act Creating a Branch Office of the Register of Deeds of Occidental Mindoro, With Permanent Station At San Jose, Occidental Mindoro.
title.orig: An Act Creating a Branch Office of the Register of Deeds of Occidental Mindoro, With Permanent Station At San Jose, Occidental Mindoro.

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1972/ra_6467_1972.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: There is hereby created a branch office of the Register of Deeds in the Municipality of San Jose, Province of Occidental Mindoro, which shall perform all the duties and functions of the register of deeds for the following municipalities: Sablayan, Rizal, Calintaan and Magsaysay.

To carry out the provisions of this Act there is appropriated out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated the sum of fourteen thousand two hundred eighty pesos which shall be spent as follows:
(a) Deputy Register of Deeds P5,400.00
(b) Clerk 2,440.00
(c) Janitor Messenger 2,440.00
(d) Sundry expenses 4,000.00 Thereafter, such sums as may be needed for the operation and maintenance of said branch office shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Enacted without Executive approval, June 17, 1972.
